# zeroword_connection (Resource)

A social login connection of an Environment. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later for the write-only client secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "google_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "zeroword_connection" "google" {
  environment_id     = zeroword_environment.staging.id
  social_provider    = "google"
  mode               = "byo"
  provider_key       = "google"
  provider_client_id = "1234.apps.googleusercontent.com"
  # Write-only: sent to Zeroword, never stored in state.
  provider_client_secret_wo = var.google_client_secret
  # Bump to send a rotated secret.
  provider_client_secret_wo_version = 1
  scopes                            = ["openid", "email", "profile"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID (`env_...`).
- `mode` (String) `managed` (Zeroword's shared OAuth app) or `byo` (your own provider app).
- `provider_client_id` (String) Client ID at the social provider.
- `provider_client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Client secret at the social provider. Write-only: never stored in state and never returned by Zeroword. Sent on create, and on update only when `provider_client_secret_wo_version` changes.
- `provider_key` (String) Key unique per Environment, used in callback URLs.
- `social_provider` (String) `google`, `apple`, `github`, `microsoft`, or `generic_oidc`.

### Optional

- `issuer` (String) Issuer URL (HTTPS). Required for `generic_oidc`.
- `owner_confirmed` (Boolean) Owner confirmation of a `generic_oidc` issuer. Set `true` to allow sign-in; changing `issuer` clears it unless this is set in the same apply. Always `true` for other providers.
- `profile_mapping` (Map of String) Mapping from Zeroword profile fields to provider claims. Defaults to empty.
- `provider_client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `provider_client_secret_wo` again (secret rotation).
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes requested from the provider (max 20). Defaults to empty.
- `status` (String) `active` or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Connection ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zeroword_connection.google con_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
